text: Workers Logs billing (log events: invocation, console and container stdout lines): "Keep, with an allowance". Each app's first 5 million log events a month are included; past that, $0.60 per million (Cloudflare's cost) + margin = $0.78/M at 30%. An explicit exception to r-2zxevg4sj675qn1m's "no per-meter allowances", so ordinary logging never appears on a bill. Config: dply.edge.usage_billing.workers_logs_included_per_app_month (5_000_000), applied per app (edge_platform_usage resource) in EdgePlatformUsageCost. (Owner answer, 2026-09-29.)
